instruction: I need to enable syntax highlighting in Vim by default. Please search online for how to enable syntax highlighting in Vim and configure my local Vim to have syntax highlighting enabled permanently.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

parameters.command:
cat > eval_syntax__5ac56f5f.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
if grep -q "^syntax on" ~/.vimrc 2>/dev/null || grep -q "^syntax enable" ~/.vimrc 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Syntax Highlighting Enabled!"
else
    echo "Syntax highlighting not found"
fi
EOF
chmod +x eval_syntax__5ac56f5f.sh
